text: The following question stood in the name of  Dr Chia Shi-Lu –   12  To ask	the Minister for Communications and Information (a) how will the Ministry ensure that SingPost improves its service quality; (b) what are the underlying causes for the numerous changes in its senior management team; and (c) whether the Ministry will consider deprivatising this essential public service.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: SingPost has also engaged an independent third-party auditor to conduct regular audits on its service and standards.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: The Member also asked about the changes to SingPost's senior management team.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: The Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA), as the regulator, focuses on ensuring that SingPost fulfils its obligations as a Public Postal Licensee with regard to meeting the postal needs of the public.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: The Member also asked whether my Ministry will consider deprivatising public postal services.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Regulatory frameworks, such as the postal Quality of service (QoS), ensure that the public postal system remains good and reliable.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: For parcel delivery, which does not require a licence from IMDA, it is fully open and competitive, and many local and international players provide services in Singapore today.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: As such, SingPost has every commercial incentive to improve its services.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: So, upon receiving such feedback, what action is being taken and how are investigations being done?
